notes.title: New update to improve original SKH and bug fix
notes.content:
OK another little update day from me, this time for the original SKH Bonus DLC.

This one fixes the menu bug that some people have been having where using the D-Pad on the main menu skips options.

Also a few visual improvments, mainly the bullets have had a little tidy up and are now more 'Glowy' and stand out more. 

Thanks again everyone, you're all awesome!!!

notes.title: Super Killer Hornet V1.2 is now live
notes.content:
Fixed a couple of issues that have been mentioned.
Addressed the controller lag that some people have mentioned, this should no longer be an issues.
The screen size can now be changed on the fly using the num keys or right thumb stick.
Game now starts windowed, pressing F will toggle full screen mode.
Also fixed a couple of other minor gameplay.

Hope this update improves your experience :)

Paul
